name: webml-community/neuron-studio
title: webml-community/neuron-studio
summary: Xenova built an interactive in-browser playground that runs Qwen3.5-4B on WebGPU and lets you push chosen neurons up or down to see how the model's output changes, reproducing a widely shared two-neuron steering recipe. Lets anyone try activation steering without a GPU setup.
